## 4. Promotion gate

SkiaSharp can encode an ICO: no (SKImage.Encode(Ico) returns null). SkiaSharp can decode one it did not write: yes.
ImageSharp's registered formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, PBM, TGA, TIFF, WEBP, EXR, QOI, ICO, CUR, ANI. ICO encode probe: encodes a single-frame ICO (9662 bytes, 1 entry, 48px); image-drift needs 48/32/16 from one render, which means one frame per size through ImageSharp's multi-frame API or the hand-written container.
A hand-written PNG-in-ICO container (`IcoFile.Write`, about 25 lines) round-trips: 2 entries read back.
